description: FDS-styled, framework-free UI animations. Each entry has a description, where-to-apply hint, keywords and copy-paste code for HTML/CSS/JS, React and Vue 2 (charts use ECharts). Fetch this to pick and apply an animation.

usage.summary: Machine-readable map of the Facilio Motion Kit. Use it to add motion to a component: match the component to an animation, then paste its code.
steps: Identify the UI component the developer is building or editing (modal, list, tabs, chart, accordion, ...).
Look it up in componentMap to get the animation id(s).
Read animations[id].code[framework] where framework is vanilla | react | vue.
Paste the code and wire it per the inline comments and animations[id].whereToApply.
For charts, merge the animation* keys into the developer’s existing ECharts option (pivot is a plain HTML table).
usage.readCodeFrom: animations.json ONLY. Do not scrape the rendered HTML pages or hand-write animation code — this file is the single source of truth.

combinations.name: Sidebar opens a menu
combinations.when: A collapsible rail expands to reveal menu items
combinations.how: Collapse/expand the rail with sidebar, then stagger the revealed menu items in with list.

combinations.name: Open a record drawer
combinations.when: A row opens a detail drawer
combinations.how: Slide the panel in with drawer; stagger its fields/cards in with intro.

combinations.name: Dashboard first load
combinations.how: Slide the shell in with movein, stagger the KPI cards with intro, let each chart animate on load.

combinations.name: Tab reveals a list
combinations.when: A tab switch shows a table/list
combinations.how: Slide the tab underline with tabs; stagger the new panel rows with list.

combinations.name: Expand a card to rows
combinations.when: An accordion opens to show rows
combinations.how: Expand height + chevron with accordion; inner rows use the same staggered reveal.

combinations.name: Filter then re-render
combinations.when: A segmented filter changes a list
combinations.how: Slide the segmented selection with slidenav; replay list after the data re-renders.

combinations.name: Select rows then act
combinations.how: Reveal the bulk bar with bulk; animate the row checkboxes with micro.

animations.name: Staggered "text + cards" intro
animations.description: Each element fades in while sliding up 16px, one after another — text first, then each card.
animations.whereToApply: Entrance — run on mount / route load. Put the marker class on each element to reveal, then call the play function.

animations.name: Smooth staggered list load-in
animations.description: Rows fade in while rising 14px and settling from 98.5% scale — GPU-composited, so long lists stay smooth.
animations.whereToApply: Entrance — run on mount / route load. Put the marker class on each element to reveal, then call the play function.

animations.name: Popover "materialize" open / close
animations.description: Grows from a tiny circular dot in the corner nearest the trigger, morphing into a rounded rectangle — and collapses back on close.
animations.whereToApply: Overlay — modal / drawer / popover / menu. Toggle the open class or state from the trigger; keep it hidden until opened.

animations.name: Slide-in shell (side nav + header)
animations.description: The side navigation slides in from the left and the global header drops in from the top, while the content eases up — a polished app-shell entrance.
animations.whereToApply: Entrance — run on mount / route load. Put the marker class on each element to reveal, then call the play function.

animations.name: Scroll-to-sticky header
animations.description: As you scroll the panel, the header smoothly condenses — shrinking its title, hiding the subtitle, and lifting with a shadow. Scroll back up and it expands again.
animations.whereToApply: Navigation / layout chrome — tabs, sidebar, sticky header or a segmented control.

animations.name: Slide-over drawer
animations.description: A right-hand panel slides in over a dimmed backdrop — open a record's detail or a create form without leaving the list. Click the scrim or ✕ to close.
animations.whereToApply: Overlay — modal / drawer / popover / menu. Toggle the open class or state from the trigger; keep it hidden until opened.

animations.name: Modal + backdrop
animations.description: The dialog scales and fades in over a dimmed, blurred backdrop; the backdrop fades independently. Click outside or Cancel to dismiss.
animations.whereToApply: Overlay — modal / drawer / popover / menu. Toggle the open class or state from the trigger; keep it hidden until opened.

animations.name: Animated tabs (hover + active)
animations.description: The underline follows your cursor on hover and settles back on the active tab when you leave; clicking slides the selection to the new tab while its panel crossfades up.
animations.whereToApply: Navigation / layout chrome — tabs, sidebar, sticky header or a segmented control.

animations.name: Sidebar collapse
animations.description: The left nav animates between full width and an icon rail; labels fade as it narrows. Toggle with the menu button.
animations.whereToApply: Navigation / layout chrome — tabs, sidebar, sticky header or a segmented control.

animations.name: Bulk-action bar
animations.description: Select one or more rows and the action bar slides up from the bottom; deselect everything and it slides away. The count stays live.
animations.whereToApply: Selection UI — reveal when one or more items are selected.

animations.name: Glide caret
animations.description: A GPU-eased caret that chases the real cursor as you type, giving a fluid typing feel. A pure visual overlay — it never mutates content, so saved text is unaffected.
animations.whereToApply: Text entry — a contentEditable field, title/inline-edit cell or single-line input surface. Enable the caret only (selection off).

code.vanilla: Chiller inspection — Tower A

animations.name: Animated selection
animations.description: The selection highlight eases into place instead of snapping, and ⌘⇧↑/↓ (Ctrl+Shift on Windows/Linux) extends the selection one visual line at a time. Native selection is suppressed so only the eased highlight shows — no double highlight.
animations.whereToApply: Text entry — a contentEditable notes / description editor or comment box. Enable selection (and lineSelect). Give the editor a transparent background so the eased highlight, painted behind the text, shows through.

animations.name: Sliding segmented control
animations.description: A subtle midground highlight slides to follow your cursor on hover, and the selected pill slides from the current segment to the one you click. Two layered indicators — hover never disturbs the selection.
animations.whereToApply: Navigation / layout chrome — tabs, sidebar, sticky header or a segmented control.

animations.name: Accordion (expand + chevron + stagger)
animations.description: Panels expand with an animated height and a rotating chevron; the rows inside stagger in as the panel opens — kept quick and capped so repeated toggles still feel snappy.
animations.whereToApply: Content object — apply to a card, row, list item, accordion or table cell.

animations.name: Toggle, checkbox & like
animations.description: Small object-state morphs: the toggle knob slides, the checkbox fills as its tick draws in, and the like button pops and fills. Kept tiny and fast.
animations.whereToApply: Content object — apply to a card, row, list item, accordion or table cell.

animations.name: Drag to reorder
animations.description: Drag a card by its handle and the others slide out of the way with a FLIP reflow — no layout jump, zero dependencies.
animations.whereToApply: Content object — apply to a card, row, list item, accordion or table cell.

animations.name: Bar — grow
animations.description: Bars grow up from the baseline, staggered left-to-right — a per-bar animationDelay in ECharts.
animations.whereToApply: Dashboard chart — merge the animation* keys into your ECharts option (pivot is a plain HTML table).

code.vue:
<!-- vue-echarts — `option` is exactly the ECharts-option tab. -->
<template>
  <v-chart :option="option" autoresize style="height:280px" />
</template>

<script>
import VChart from "vue-echarts";           // v6: register modules via echarts/core use([...])
export default { components: { 'v-chart': VChart }, data: () => ({ option }) };
</script>
